action_review: Stop and stand cases require a source-declared original operator action and service-brake state for all 600 joined Native rows. The diagnostic command distinguishes action plans; it is not a legal classification or proof of an original event.
driveway_review: Reviewer binds public/private driveway opening and curb station to original sources. Private authority requires one specific source-declared role (owner, controller, family member or invitee), with aggregate authority agreeing with that role. USPS vehicle identity and official business, traffic-conflict necessity, applicable law, and officer/device directions each require original source declaration. The Native runner emits a context template and does not assert these facts.
limits: Offline and synthetic CPU tests do not establish an actual driveway, Native motion, source review, physical acceptance or statutory compliance.
measurement: Compute body-footprint gap to driveway opening on each stationary frame. Five feet equals 1.524 m. Preserve the exact boundary, in-front overlap, each exception context and full 600-frame time join without a legal verdict.
trace_origin: Original CARLA snapshot time, Native vehicle pose and projected bounding-box vertices on capture; synthetic_native_sample only for CPU diagnostics
